source: 160 kept 4/4 songs (CoCoPops Billboard), the sung tune; made by lib/luthier/make_kept_rhythm_room.py; studied in studies/rhythm_memory

what.room: the share of bars, between the first and last sung note, in which nothing is sung
what.contrast: the spread, across windows of four bars, of onsets a bar, over the mean
what.rhythm_scaling: detrended fluctuation of the onsets on a grid of sixteenths
